parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Upload a GLB file of the 3D model you want to remesh.

parameters.name: topology
parameters.description: Choose the mesh structure type used for the generated model. For Quad, choose output format 'obj'

parameters.name: targetPolycount
parameters.description: Set the approximate number of polygons for your 3D model. Higher values increase detail, while lower values create simpler meshes.

parameters.name: resizeHeight
parameters.description: Adjust the model's height in meters. Set to 0 to keep the original scale.

parameters.name: originAt
parameters.description: Define where the model's origin point is positioned. Leave empty to keep the default origin.
